hook.say: Turquoise water, ancient ruins and a mountain that is on fire. Five questions on Turkey's sunny coasts!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which sea washes Türkiye's west coast?
questions.say: Which sea washes Turkey's west coast?
questions.fact: Ancient Ephesus and Troy both lie near the Aegean coast.
questions.sayAnswer: The Aegean Sea! Ancient Ephesus and Troy both lie near the Aegean coast.

questions.q: What is a "gulet", the star of the Blue Cruise?
questions.say: What is a goolet, the star of the Blue Cruise?
questions.fact: Gulets are built mainly in Bodrum and Marmaris.
questions.sayAnswer: A wooden sailing boat! Goolets are built mainly in Bodrum and Marmaris.

questions.q: The Lycian Way hiking trail runs between Fethiye and which city?
questions.say: The Lycian Way hiking trail runs between Fet-hee-yeh and which city?
questions.fact: The waymarked trail along the ancient Lycian coast opened in 1999.
questions.sayAnswer: Antalya! The waymarked trail along the ancient Lycian coast opened in 1999.

questions.q: St Nicholas, the original Santa Claus, was bishop of which city?
questions.say: Saint Nicholas, the original Santa Claus, was bishop of which city?
questions.fact: Myra is today's Demre in Antalya. He was born in nearby Patara.
questions.sayAnswer: Myra! That is today's Demre, in Antalya, and he was born in nearby Patara.

questions.q: What makes Yanartaş, near Olympos, so unusual?
questions.say: What makes Yanar-tash, near Olympos, so unusual?
questions.fact: Natural gas fires have burned there for at least 2,500 years.
questions.sayAnswer: Flames from the rock! Natural gas fires have burned there for at least 2500 years.
